semiconductor_relevance: High — Synergie Cad Group specializes in PCB design and manufacturing, particularly for semiconductor test interfaces, making them a relevant player in the semiconductor supply chain.
summary: Synergie Cad Group provides comprehensive PCB design and manufacturing solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on high-demand test interfaces. With over 30 years of experience, they offer turn-key services that include design, simulation, and manufacturing, supported by strategic partnerships for high-volume production.
capabilities: PCB design and manufacturing for semiconductor test interfaces
Turn-key solutions for small and mid-size series production
Partnerships with Tier1 OSATs for high-volume packaging
Custom socket and DUT board solutions

regional_presence.Europe: The company operates a manufacturing hub in Toulouse, France, focusing on packaging and testing services.
